title: Paclitaxel allergy changes medication safety decision
task: As of the decision date, determine whether paclitaxel is safe to include in the next chemotherapy plan based only on documented allergy and infusion reaction history.

record.text: Discussed carboplatin and paclitaxel. Allergies reviewed: no known drug allergies.
Prior paclitaxel infusion caused anaphylaxis with hypotension and wheezing. Paclitaxel listed as severe allergy.

clinical_rationale: A severe paclitaxel reaction is the controlled contraindication-like change.
